title: Dock Zero: Last Light
description: Hold the line through eight escalating waves in a rain-swept container port, or enter an offline six-bot free-for-all.

defaultCaptions.x: Dock Zero: Last Light. Eight waves. One operator. The harbor is still hostile.
defaultCaptions.facebook: A tactical operator is the last signal in a storm-lit harbor terminal. Survive the escalating waves and face the exoskeleton siege, or take on six combat bots in offline free-for-all.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Dock Zero: Last Light — an offline FPS set in a cinematic container terminal. Eight survival waves, a three-phase boss, or six-bot free-for-all.
defaultCaptions.discord: Dock Zero: Last Light — a rainy harbor terminal, eight survival waves, a three-phase exoskeleton boss, and an offline six-bot free-for-all.
